title: PR-001 security gate registry v1 (SG-00~SG-10 ownership, claims and filesystem policy)
description: Schema for security_gate_registry_v1.json. That file is CONFIGURATION, not state: it freezes which RT owns which SG, the exact single receipt path per RT, the exact frozen claim_id requirement set each receipt must reproduce, the filesystem_policy governing the six SG-03 attack classes, and the producer/consumer phases that make the dependency graph acyclic. This schema therefore deliberately admits NO status, conclusion, verdict, result or pass/fail field anywhere: those live only inside receipts, and a registry that could record them would be state masquerading as config. Exactly ten entries, one per RT-017..RT-026, no more and no fewer.

receipt_root.description: The single directory under which every declared receipt_path must live. Any file found under this root that is not at a declared receipt_path is an undeclared receipt and fails closed.

managed_script_inventory.description: Closed ownership inventory for every managed CWK Python script plus explicitly named non-namespace entry points. A path is declared exactly once as RT-owned, central shared ABI, or immutable legacy. The sole two-RT owner path is separately governed by shared_evolution_paths. Candidate commits may not add an undeclared scripts/cwk_*.py path.

plan_matrix_ref.description: Pointer to the DERIVED Markdown matrix. Documentation only: never consulted to decide ownership, coverage or status.

sg_ids.description: The closed set of eleven security gates. Frozen order and membership.

filesystem_attack_classes.description: The six SG-03 attack classes, frozen. Exactly the required key set of a receipt's filesystem_coverage object.

phase_order.description: Total order of lifecycle phases. Acyclicity is decided by index comparison in this array, so its order is frozen.

write_phase_allowlist.description: The only phases in which a security receipt may be written. go_no_go_evaluation is deliberately excluded, so the evaluator is not an authorized declared writer of the receipts it consumes, and identity exclusion is recomputed against the injected go_no_go_evaluator_identity rather than self-declared. SCOPE HONESTY: this is INTERFACE-LEVEL authorship/phase exclusion enforced by this contract, NOT OS-level write denial. It shows the evaluator is not the authorized declared writer of what it consumes; it does NOT show the kernel refused the evaluation process write access. OS-level read-only execution requires RT-026 AC-026-11: a trusted launcher that imposes the write denial, a launcher-signed run attestation (never self-issued by the evaluator), pre/post exact manifests over the receipt trees that must be item-for-item equal, and real write-denial evidence in which create, rewrite, rename and delete are each actually attempted and rejected (EROFS/EPERM or equivalent) -- 'no write was observed' is not evidence. No Wave-0 artifact may claim OS-level read-only execution.

go_no_go_evaluator_identity.description: Frozen opaque identity of the read-only go/no-go evaluator. Injected into preflight validation and compared against producer/verifier; the receipt's own evaluator_identity_excluded boolean is a declaration, not the proof.

entries.description: Exactly ten entries, one per RT-017..RT-026, each appearing exactly once.

receipt_path.description: The single exact path of this RT's security receipt. Always <receipt_root>/RT-0NN/receipt.json; the NN must equal producer_rt's ordinal.

owner_evidence_path_prefixes.description: Repo-relative prefixes of this entry's EVIDENCE OUTPUT. A path under one of these is explicitly disqualified from counting as owner code scope.

owner_test_file_prefixes.description: Root-level Python test namespace owned by this RT. This is a basename prefix, not a recursive path selector.

required_security_test_files.description: Mandatory security/path test files that must exist as regular tracked blobs at tested_subject_commit and match owner_test_file_prefixes.

owner_evolution_stage_indices.description: Exact script-evolution stages owned by this RT. Shared tenant_cli ownership is legal only through stages 3 and 7.

required_shared_abi_ids.description: Central ABI dependencies bound into subject/evaluation equality but forbidden from satisfying owner touch.

unresolved_owner_surface_requirements.description: Contract-required code surfaces whose exact paths are not yet frozen. Empty for a signable receipt; any non-empty value makes receipt validation fail closed.

receipt_kind.description: Must equal the receipt_kind inside the receipt. preflight-security is permitted only for RT-026.

producer_task_id.description: The task in this RT's own task list that produces the receipt. Must exist in producer_task_ref.

producer_role.description: Who signs. Never the RT's own implementer acting alone, and never a downstream consumer.

producer_phase.description: Must be a member of write_phase_allowlist; go_no_go_evaluation is structurally excluded.

owned_sg_ids.description: The SGs this RT evidences. Non-empty; the union across all ten entries must equal sg_ids exactly.

claims.description: The frozen requirement set. Each claim_id is globally unique across the whole registry and permanently bound to one sg_id. A receipt's claims[].claim_id set must equal this set exactly.

requirement.description: What must be true. A requirement, not a status: no pass/fail language belongs here.

na_permitted_claim_ids.description: The only claim_ids this entry may answer not_applicable. Normally empty. A receipt answering not_applicable for any claim_id outside this list fails closed.

permitted_reason_codes.description: The reason codes admissible for this entry's N/A answers. Must be empty when na_permitted_claim_ids is empty.

path_attack_applicability.description: Frozen answer to whether the SG-03 filesystem family applies. Must agree with filesystem_policy.mode.

mode.description: applicable = all six classes must be applicable with tests_run>0, runtime_surfaces and executable_refs. not_applicable_permitted = all six must be not_applicable with reason_code + reason + static_evidence_refs. Mixing is rejected.

permitted_reason_codes.description: Must be empty when mode=applicable and non-empty when mode=not_applicable_permitted.

path_attack_note.description: Why the family applies, or the concrete reason it cannot. Required in both directions: silence is not an option.

consumers.description: Who reads this receipt and in which phase. Every consumer_phase must be strictly later than producer_phase in phase_order.

owner_code_path_prefixes.description: Security owner selectors. A trailing slash means a recursive directory that must be non-empty at tested_subject_commit. Without a trailing slash the value is one exact regular tracked file, never a string prefix. Selectors are part of the v2 digest manifest.

semanticRules: this registry is configuration, not state. No key anywhere in the document may be one of forbiddenKeys, at any depth: a registry that can record a verdict would let ownership config be edited into a PASS.
entries must contain exactly the ten producer_rt values RT-017..RT-026, each exactly once, in ascending order.
each entry's receipt_path must be <receipt_root>/<producer_rt>/receipt.json, so path and producer_rt can never disagree.
receipt_kind=preflight-security is permitted only for RT-026; every other entry must be rt-security.
producer_phase must be a member of write_phase_allowlist. go_no_go_evaluation is excluded by enum as well as by allowlist, so the evaluator cannot be declared a producer.

for every entry and every consumer, phase_order.index(producer_phase) < phase_order.index(consumer_phase). This single index comparison is the machine-checkable anti-cycle rule and it is what permits RT-026 to consume its own preflight receipt without a self-dependency.
the union of owned_sg_ids across all ten entries must equal sg_ids exactly: no uncovered SG, no SG outside the closed set.
SG-03 must be owned by all ten entries, so filesystem coverage is provable package by package and no package can be silently skipped.
every claim_id in the document must be globally unique, and its numeric RT segment must match the entry's producer_rt (SGC-022-xx may only appear under RT-022).
the sg_ids referenced by an entry's claims must be exactly that entry's owned_sg_ids as a set: every owned SG needs at least one claim, and no claim may cite an SG the entry does not own.
na_permitted_claim_ids must be a subset of this entry's own claims[].claim_id.
permitted_reason_codes must be empty when na_permitted_claim_ids is empty, and non-empty otherwise.

path_attack_applicability=applicable requires filesystem_policy.mode=applicable with empty permitted_reason_codes; path_attack_applicability=not_applicable requires mode=not_applicable_permitted with non-empty permitted_reason_codes. The two fields may never disagree.
filesystem_policy.required_classes must equal filesystem_attack_classes exactly for every entry: no entry may narrow the six classes.

RT-022 is the only entry permitted to declare path_attack_applicability=not_applicable, and only because the Broker core has no filesystem write surface; its N/A must still be backed by static evidence refs in the receipt.
a receipt's producer_rt, receipt_kind, producer_phase and consumers must equal the values frozen here; a receipt may never widen its own consumer set or relabel its own phase.
status is never stored here. An SG entry is NOT_RUN iff receipt_path does not exist, and otherwise takes the status and conclusion recorded inside that receipt. Absence fails closed to NO_GO.
any file present under receipt_root that is not at a declared receipt_path is an undeclared receipt and is a hard failure, not a bonus.

owner_code_path_prefixes, owner_test_file_prefixes, required_security_test_files and owner_evolution_stage_indices must match the executable exact-scope map for each producer_rt. Exact-file selectors and directory selectors use different semantics; lookalike string prefixes never match. Directory selectors and test prefixes must be non-empty at tested_subject_commit, and every required test must exist there as a regular blob.

owner selectors may name planned paths before a receipt exists, but a present receipt is invalid when any exact file is absent, any directory selector is empty, any required test is absent, or unresolved_owner_surface_requirements is non-empty.

cross-entry selector overlap is forbidden except for the single exact shared_evolution_paths path scripts/cwk_tenant_cli.py. That file is owned by RT-019 stage 3 and RT-026 stage 7 only and must be validated through the pinned append-only script-evolution chain.

owner_code_path_prefixes may never select a reports, receipts, security-receipts, capability-receipts, gate-receipts or release-gate-receipts path component. Such outputs belong only in owner_evidence_path_prefixes and never count as code.

owner_scope_tree_sha256 is the domain-separated v2 digest of the canonical selector manifest plus all selected regular Git blob records at tested_subject_commit. Every immutable selected record must be byte-identical at the explicit evaluation candidate; only the declared shared evolution file may advance through its later declared stage.

all executable and static refs must be root-level files in the producer RT's owner_test_file_prefixes namespace and must bind the same bytes at tested_subject_commit, evaluation commit and fail-closed current read. Executable refs must pass the canonical acceptance-test validator: direct unittest.TestCase, one unique direct test_ method, no decorators, aliases, inherited/class-level skips, delete/rebind/overwrite, and a real self.assert*/self.fail call.

shared_abi_dependencies is a separate neutral dependency family, never an RT owner selector. Each entry's required_shared_abi_ids must exactly agree with the dependency consumer_rts set. Its exact blobs enter the v2 subject/evaluation digest and equality check but can never satisfy owner touch. Planned absence is allowed only while no security receipt exists.

managed_script_inventory is an exact global partition of every scripts/cwk_[a-z0-9_]+.py path plus install.sh into RT-owned, central shared ABI, or immutable legacy path+mode+SHA. The only two-owner path is scripts/cwk_tenant_cli.py under stages 3 then 7. An undeclared managed path, category collision, legacy drift, selected symlink/gitlink, extra specs/tasks member, or test-namespace lookalike is invalid.

the v2 manifest binds script_evolution_policy_ref, script_evolution_policy_sha256 and each owner stage's exact stage_index, owner_rt, target_path, receipt_path and ordinal derived from the pinned policy. Verification replays the chain, checks companion immutable pins and calls the canonical tenant-CLI verifier for actual slots plus frozen AST/comment fingerprints.

the complete pinned evolution policy is replayed for every security receipt, including completed RT-012 stage 9 and RT-013 stage 10 even though both owners are outside the RT-017..026 security producer set. scripts/cwk_instance.py and scripts/cwk_agent_binding.py must equal their final tips and managed-inventory path/mode/SHA pins; neither bootstrap stage ever counts as a future SG entry's owner touch.

receipt validation fails closed when the worktree is dirty, the index has assume-unchanged or skip-worktree bits, selected disk bytes differ from the explicit evaluation commit, or a selected directory/test namespace contains an untracked, ignored, symlinked, hardlinked or special entry.
